title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::

items.text: When I come home from school my mother is always glad to see me.
I take off my backpack and wash my hands and feet.
I usually do my homework before dinner.
If I can't figure out my homework, I can always look on the internet.
I like to learn new things.
Dinnertime is the only time my family is together.
We always have great conversations at dinner time.
I enjoy listening to how their days were.
I watch TV every evening with my family.
But my mother doesn't allow us to watch TV very long.
I like watching sports and comedy programs.
But my father likes watching the news.
I usually go to bed around 10 o'clock.
Before I go to bed, I write in my diary and prepare my bag for school.
My days are very busy but also I have a lot of fun.
